title: The Vanished Crown
scene: At 7:45 PM, the glitter crown vanished from the prop table. The theater power was out from 7:30 to 7:50. One of the four is lying.

suspects.name: Dana Reyes
suspects.testimony: I was giving the cast a pep talk onstage from 7:35 to 7:50. I never went near the prop table.
suspects.alibiProof: The cast's group selfie is timestamped 7:44, with Dana standing in the middle onstage.

suspects.name: Felix Moran
suspects.testimony: I was testing the spotlights in the booth from 7:35 to 7:50. I stayed there the whole time.
suspects.contradiction: The booth log shows no power draw until 7:50, and glitter was stuck to his sleeve.

suspects.name: Nell Ashby
suspects.testimony: I was hemming a cloak by the wardrobe window, since it was the only light. I was there at 7:40.
suspects.alibiProof: Her phone photo of the half-hemmed cloak is timestamped 7:41, taken at the wardrobe window.

suspects.name: Owen Hart
suspects.testimony: I was fetching candles from the storage closet for the outage. I got back around 7:45.
suspects.alibiProof: The candle sign-out sheet is signed 7:42, and the janitor saw him in the closet.
